Welcome to Mount Anthony Veterinary Hospital!
Come and see what we’re all about…we’d love to meet you and your pet!
Mount Anthony Veterinary Hospital is a full-service animal hospital offering
veterinary services
for cats, dogs, and pocket pets since 1988.
Our warm, friendly
veterinary staff
is dedicated to serving our clients both professionally and with attention to your pet’s individual needs. We are committed to offering reliable advice and excellence in veterinary care. New clients are always welcome.
To learn more or schedule an appointment for your dog, cat, or pocket pet, please call us at
(802) 442-4324

Now Available: Mobile App & Online Booking
We have some exciting new features available at Mount Anthony Veterinary Hospital! You can now easily schedule appointments directly online via desktop or mobile device for your furry friends. We also have a new mobile app through PetDesk, which we encourage you to download to book appointments, request refills, view and share your pet's vaccination records, and more.

The Key to a Long, Happy Life for Cats and Dogs
National Pet Wellness Month serves as an annual reminder that routine veterinary exams, proper nutrition, and preventative care are essential for catching health issues early and ensuring a long, happy life for cats and dogs.
